evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-14"} returned 201 and the todo came back with dueDate "2026-10-14". A POST without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null. The date is a plain calendar date with no time.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/3 with {"dueDate":"2026-03-01"} returned 200 and the date changed from 2026-12-01 to 2026-03-01. PATCH with {"clearDueDate":true} returned 200 and dueDate became null. A PATCH with {"dueDate":null} was a no-op and kept the date, but clearDueDate does remove it.
evidence.AC3: POST with dueDate "2026-02-30", "15.10.2026" and "2026-10-15T10:00:00" each returned HTTP 400. PATCH with dueDate "2026-02-30" also returned 400.
evidence.AC4: Today is 2026-10-15 (UTC). Test data: past due (10-14), due today (10-15), no due date, future date, and a done todo with a past date. GET /todos?overdue=true returned only the todo due 2026-10-14. The due-today, no-date, and done todos were excluded.
evidence.AC5: The list page at / showed due dates next to the todos as 14.10.2026, 15.10.2026 and 01.01.2026. Todos without a due date showed none.
evidence.AC6: Only the todo due 14.10.2026 showed the text "überfällig" in the page snapshot. The todos due today, with no date, and done with a past date had no marker.
evidence.AC7: The page has a checkbox labelled "nur überfällige". I clicked it, and the list then showed only the overdue todo "past"; the four other todos disappeared.
